chunks: If any one of them said: "I am God besides Him," We should award him Hell; for this is how We requite the evil-doers.
ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for someone who claims to be a god besides Allah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate consequence of *ghuluw* (exaggeration in divinity) or claiming independent lordship, serving as a warning against attributing divine attributes to created beings. It underscores the principle of *Tawhid* by illustrating that self-deification leads to eternal retribution, specifically linking the claimant to the broader category of *al-Zalimin* (the wrongdoers) who transgress divine boundaries.
